output.answer_markdown: The passages do not support the premise. Costco did not stop charging membership fees in fiscal 2023: membership fees were $4,580 million in 2023, up 8% from $4,224 million in 2022 [6], and the company continued to account for membership fee revenue on a deferred basis over the one-year membership period, with deferred membership fees of $2,337 million at the end of 2023 [8]. No passage gives any reason for ending membership fees.

claims.text: Costco's membership fees were $4,580 million in fiscal 2023, so it did not stop charging them.

provenance.quote: Deferred membership fees at the end of 2023 and 2022 were $2,337 and $2,174.

claims.text: Deferred membership fees were $2,337 million at the end of 2023.
